name: Jalan Transolutions (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2003, Jalan Transolutions Ltd is engaged in the transportation business.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
JTL provides logistics services primarily to 2-wheeler companies. 
The company's headquarters is in Delhi, with 25 branches located 
in all major cities in India. It has a fleet of over 400 singles /multi axle carriers, providing a diverse range of logistic services. 
The company also provides Full Truck Load (FTL) & Less than 
Truck Load (LTL) services.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -6.07%
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -46.5% over past five years.
Company has high debtors of 199 days.
